purpose: Final engineering semantic retrieval qualification gate for UC2.
scope: Engineering retrieval-configuration qualification only; not a thesis benchmark result.
methodological_note: One prospectively frozen semantic probe per accepted UC2 document. Queries are paraphrases of frozen scope/adjudication metadata and were fixed before retrieval execution.

design.expected_target: rank of first retrieved chunk belonging to pre-specified expected document

engineering_acceptance_gate.note: Prospectively scaled from frozen UC1 gate 7/6/4/7 of 8 using CEILING for 17 probes.
